description: KOMA IRoyaltyRouter.route split vectors. All integers are decimal strings except depth. depth = number of registered ancestors above the routed series (0 = root); only the nearest 8 are paid, so ancestors[] has min(depth, 8) entries, ancestors[0] = parent (kind 1). character (kind 0) includes the unpaid remix-pool remainder and dust; treasury is kind 2. character + treasury + sum(ancestors) == amount. On-chain, zero-amount legs are skipped (no transfer, no Routed event). Payment order: ancestors nearest-first, character, treasury. amount > (2^256-1)/4000 reverts (amount*4000 overflows). Split: character 40% / remix pool 20% / treasury 40% (bps 4000/2000/4000).
